rules.description: Checks date freshness across 2022 education cohorts, 2010 school networks, and 2000 PreVestibular.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MaxDate, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_svs FROM stats
params.condition: (CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Count_Student', 'Count_Student_Nursery', 'Count_Student_PreKindergarten', 'Count_Student_AdultEducation', 'Count_Student_PrimarySchool', 'Count_Student_BrazilHighSchool', 'Count_Student_UndergraduateLevel', 'Count_Student_PostGraduateLevel') THEN MaxDate >= '2022' WHEN StatVar = 'Count_Student_BrazilPreVestibular' THEN MaxDate >= '2000' ELSE MaxDate >= '2010' END) AND total_svs > 0

rules.description: Checks date consistency across active 2022 education StatVars.
Checks that every education StatVar covers at least 33 places.
